title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Oct. 14
summary: Oil rose as a flare-up in attacks in the Middle East increased uncertainty over a recovery in Persian Gulf energy flows.

title: Gold Steady as Fed Official’s Remarks Temper Rate-Hike Bets
summary: Gold held a two-day decline after a Federal Reserve official signaled one more interest-rate hike may be needed this year, but further tightening won’t be necessary in 2027, improving sentiment toward the precious metal.

title: Asian Stocks Rise on Fed Rate Signal, Oil Gains: Markets Wrap
summary: Asian stocks bounced after two days of losses on expectations the Federal Reserve may not need to raise interest rates aggressively next year. American crude extended its rally.

title: South Africa Fund Manager Tips Nigerian Stocks Over South Korea
summary: Allan Gray Ltd., which oversees $29 billion in assets, favors Nigerian stocks over South Korean equities, as they offer a diversification play from the artificial-intelligence frenzy that has swept markets from Wall Street to Asia.

title: Bank of America Fined More Than $1.2 Billion for Money-Laundering
summary: Bank of America was fined more than $1.21 billion for money laundering and sanctions violations by US regulators. Katherine Doherty has more on "The Asia Trade." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Hong Kong’s Low Aggregate Balance Sparks Rate Volatility Concern
summary: As the Hong Kong dollar nears the weak end of its trading band, strategists see currency defenses raising the risk of volatility in borrowing costs, with interbank cash reserves sitting near historical lows.

title: Aramco Headquarters Hit as Houthi Missiles Strike Saudi Arabia
summary: Saudi Aramco’s executive headquarters in eastern Saudi Arabia was hit during a missile attack by Yemen’s Houthi militants on Tuesday, causing a fire in a part of the complex, the kingdom’s energy ministry said.

title: Asia’s Coal Appetite Endures as Winter Looms and Supply Tightens
summary: Asian thermal coal prices have surged to a two-year high as power plants stockpile fuel for winter, tightening a market already strained by elevated demand and supply disruptions from China to Indonesia.

title: Kiwi Exodus to Australia Hits 13-Year High Ahead of Election
summary: New Zealand’s exodus of citizens to Australia accelerated in the first three months of the year, reaching the highest in 13 years in a further blow to the government just weeks from an election, latest data show.

title: World-Beating China Bonds Can Overcome Paltry Yields, Funds Say
summary: China’s world-beating bonds have dodged the selloff in global debt and some fund managers are positioning for further gains due to a strong yuan and a sluggish domestic economy.

title: DGB Offers Ethan Allen CEO a Non-Board Advisory Role
summary: DGB Investments has offered an olive branch of sorts to the head of Ethan Allen Interiors Inc. as the activist seeks to replace the furniture company’s board and chief executive officer.

title: Glencore Set for ASX Debut in Test of Mining Giant’s Allure
summary: Glencore Plc begins trading on the Australian Securities Exchange on Wednesday after a listing that didn’t involve selling new shares or raising funds, in a test of the company’s ability to attract cash from a fresh pool of capital.

title: KKR Sees Bond Rout as Opening to Lock in High-Grade Asian Credit
summary: The global bond rout is giving fixed-income investors a rare chance to lock in Asian junk bond-like payouts without the credit risk of such debt, according to KKR & Co.

title: Rio Tinto Maintains Copper Output as Iron Ore Sales Increase
summary: Rio Tinto Group’s copper production remained steady in the third quarter as a strong performance at its Mongolian mine offset declines elsewhere, while shipments of iron ore rose marginally.

title: Palliser Asks Samsung to Issue ADRs to Buy Back Preferred Shares
summary: Palliser Capital wants Samsung Electronics Co. to list shares in the US and use the proceeds to buy back preferred stock, saying the company should do more to narrow the discount on those securities, which carry no voting rights.

title: Major US Power Grids Strain Under Heat During Peak Repair Season
summary: Power supplies are tightening on grids that serve roughly one-third of the US population, as a short-lived blast of heat in the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic collides with planned off-season maintenance outages.

title: Fed's Collins Says Rates Will Likely Need to Rise More
summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston President Susan Collins says interest rates will likely need to rise more before the end of the year to help rein in inflation during a banking conference hosted by the Boston Fed. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Skydance Bonds Extend Losses Amid Warner Bros. Buyout Angst
summary: Skydance Corp. bonds weakened further on Tuesday, and the cost of protecting the company’s debt against default jumped, as investors fretted about the profitability of the company after its $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc.

title: Big Take: How India’s Options Market Imploded
summary: Millions chased fast profits through complex trades. It ended with billions lost. How India’s options market unraveled and where retail traders go from here. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Citadel Securities’ Rubner Says Retail Traders Return to AI Bets
summary: Skittish retail investors are coming back around to their favorite bet: artificial intelligence.
